title: confirmation.json
description: Second-layer check of a reviewer verdict against its own evidence, run before the verdict takes effect. The confirmer re-reads the evidence and the evidence bars; it does not re-run the work. The engine takes the reviewer's verdict only when upheld, otherwise the weaker of the two — a downgrade never raises trust (ACCEPT may fall to REJECT or ESCALATE, never the reverse).

upheld.description: true when the evidence meets the bar for the reviewer's verdict.

supported.description: The verdict the evidence actually supports. When upheld is false, an ACCEPT that rests only on agent_claim/reviewer_inference drops to ESCALATE.
